summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world and ensure the villager trade rebalance is enabled.
2. Level an armorer villager up to either expert or master level.
3. Save and quit the world.
4. Reopen the world.
5. Interact with the armorer villager.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers in a world where the villager trade rebalance is enabled, the game experiences a client crash if the villager's career and level could potentially generate trades of the ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type that include enchanted items, such as those offered by a plains armorer. To reproduce this issue, players need to create a new world with the villager trade rebalance activated, then level an armorer to either expert or master level, noting that this issue does not apply to expert-level taiga villagers. After saving and quitting the world, reopening it and interacting with the leveled armorer will result in a game crash. This behavior has been documented in crash reports from both a vanilla client and a deobfuscated version using official mappings, providing valuable insights for developers to investigate the problem further.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with villagers while the villager trade rebalance is enabled, the game should function normally without crashing. Players should be able to successfully trade with villagers, including those at expert or master levels, and receive enchanted items as part of their trades. The trading process should be seamless, allowing players to enjoy the trading mechanics without any interruptions or errors, thus ensuring a stable gameplay experience.
